subject: planner: move physical projection related logic into physical op dir (#62533)
summary: Refactor moves `PhysicalProjection` from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop` and relocates its methods (Init/Explain/ResolveIndices/cost/ToPB/Attach2Task/plan-cache clone) without changing logic. Planner-core functionality that can’t live in `physicalop` (task attach, resolve-indices, cost) is now reached via `utilfuncp` function pointers wired in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`; executor/planner call sites are updated to use the new type. Reviewed the moved implementations and the init wiring; no plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics/runtime regressions found in planner/executor behavior.
